title: Prove sharp numerical bounds inside actual matching layers
body:
The existing full-Toeplitz physical-cut audit leaves its numerical contract at a proper subset of a matching layer open. This adds a four-way source-bound interpolation theorem: prefix, suffix and both inverse operators obey `sqrt(a²+b²)` from adjacent complete-boundary bounds. The generic `sqrt(2)` loss is sharp even when all four complete-boundary contracts hold together. The proof binds the coordinate projections to the actual retained rational FFT and dirty Toeplitz-shear matching gates.

The resulting child/Full implication retains the original complete-layer bounds as premises: sublayer fragments use `sqrt(2) H` (safe rational `2H`), physical cuts use `sqrt(2) K`, and arbitrary segments use `2K²`. One extra data bit funds the doubled suffix envelope only when the original rounding-event count is retained. Gate-internal arithmetic, overlapping/asynchronous operations, physical delivery and full supplier admission remain separate. No selected κ changes.

Validation: registered warning-strict CPython 3.12 normal/optimized replay passes 97 cuts, 52 proper sublayer cuts, 388 exact interpolation identities and 388 partial-cut spectral certificates. Six controls cover the missing loss, projection side, overlap and complex-adjoint boundaries. Committed-byte/source-history and official 13-file export integrity pass. Git-free normal/optimized replays with `PATH=/nonexistent` pass (0.743/0.673 s locally); all exported bytes remain unchanged. Source-byte corruption and a wrong-projection implementation mutant reject. Hosted CI has not yet been verified.

This PR has three substantive commits: quantified theorem/matrix oracle; actual-source replay and discriminating controls; finalized contracts and independent PSD-certified neighboring spectral envelopes. Canonical investigation: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4202#discussioncomment-19138297 . Base `b91956876e5b4122fd89179f1b57557ff8378f15`, priority revision 7. Entry overlap covered 317 open PRs, 4,064 discussion records and 6,636 current-base notes; no exhaustive novelty claim.

Credit Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml for rational FFT/Full and numerical fragment contracts, Vlado Vojdanovski/PR1673 for the matching scheduler, Chafik Boukhalfa/PR628 for certified phases, and Brian/JoyboyBrian's physical-cut trace audit. Prepared by JoyboyBrian with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. The written proof establishes the quantified implication; finite checks and author-process review do not constitute independent human or proof-kernel acceptance. Open next questions are in the package.

Submission checkpoint: fresh official main at 04:59 UTC remains `b91956876e5b4122fd89179f1b57557ff8378f15`, with unchanged guidance and affected source inputs. Complete submission overlap covers 318 open PRs (04:59:29 UTC), 4,077 discussion records (05:00:22 UTC), and all 6,636 current-base notes. Scoped matching/sublayer and downset/allocation queries identify the credited explicit predecessor obligations and this round's claims; no exhaustive novelty assertion is made. Coordinating Codex review independently read the full four-way proof, sharpness construction and exact source cut oracle, with no blocker.
